what: The public host's Content-Security-Policy, verbatim: the header the site serves today, and the header after the owner-approved change.

provenance.checkout: not carried in this repository (set SYNERGY_SERVICES_WEBSITE to a local checkout of synergy-services-website)
provenance.format: single-line minified JSON; the policy is a JSON string value (escaped quotes in the file) and the header is that string's unescaped value, byte-for-byte
provenance.approval: issue #24 — the owner-approved change adds 'wasm-unsafe-eval' to script-src in that file; this repository never edits the website repository
provenance.derivation: resultingHeader is currentHeader with one token inserted into script-src: 'self' 'unsafe-inline' becomes 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; nothing else changes, so removing the token from the resulting header reproduces the current header byte-for-byte (asserted in tests/deployment-serving.test.js)

currentHeader: default-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'self'; form-action 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; frame-src https://www.google.com; upgrade-insecure-requests
resultingHeader: default-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'self'; form-action 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; frame-src https://www.google.com; upgrade-insecure-requests
